title: Chapter 326 Thunder Skeleton King
content:
Chapter 326 Thunder Skeleton King

"Gong Zheng, withdraw."

Just after Gong Zheng jumped down from the battlement, Wang Shuo quickly threw the thunder bomb.

"Boom..."

The explosion sounded, and a part of the city wall was blown up. There were less than two tentacles left on the ladder, which were shaky.

Wang Shuo threw another 5 bombs, and after an explosion, the ladder finally fell off the city wall.

With a long breath, he hurried to the next place and blew it up in the same way.

25 thunder bombs, the explosion power was just right, which could not only blow up the ladder, but also protect the city wall to the greatest extent.

Soon, the ladder that Wang Shuo was responsible for defending was broken.

Sauron on the city wall saw this and cast an admiring look.

Zhao Bangde stood on the city gate tower and nodded.

At this moment, the war drums of the undead sounded again.

"What's going to happen again?"

All the undead rushed forward.

The whole army attacked.

Even 8 of the 10 generals have been dispatched.

But General Arif Ubol did not move.

I don't know whether he felt that he had already won the battle or was afraid of something.

The undead on the ladder started to jump from a distance, and it was impossible to defend against it.

The only way was to cut off the ladder.

Seeing this, Suo Yong came to the side of a ladder without hesitation.

He took out a narrow long knife, held it tightly with both hands, raised it above his head, and a fierceness appeared on his scarred face.

"Open."

The long knife slashed on the ladder, cutting off four or five tentacles with one stroke.

Sauron frowned. He used 70% of his strength in this knife, but only cut off half of it. He didn't have time to think about it, and he cut it again with another knife, destroying the ladder.

But at this time, the number of undead warriors rushing up the wall was almost one-third of the number of defenders on the wall.

The situation was already very critical.

At this time, undead warriors were climbing the city gates everywhere, and three warriors came up from each of the east and west gates.

Some warriors threw a rope in their hands, and their bodies flew into the air with just this little pulling force. Ordinary arrows were blocked by an invisible aura on their bodies and could not hurt them at all.

Zhao Bangde glanced at the west gate, frowned, stepped on the roof and ran quickly.

"Boss, do you think you are running away from the battlefield?"

Wang Shuo widened his eyes and wondered.

Seeing that Sauron was still defending the city gate and the defenders of Shanhai City had not collapsed, he believed that Zhao Bangde did not run away.

Wang Shuo did not know the situation of the west gate. He only knew that two warriors had confronted Sauron and one was slaughtering soldiers.

"Wang Shuo, come over to support and stop that warrior."

Suo Yong gave Wang Shuo an order.

Wang Shuo took a closer look and took a breath of cold air. Ordinary soldiers, that skeleton warrior, could kill a kid with one sword, and the soldiers of Shanhai City could also kick him away with one kick.

The enemy is very strong! But the situation is critical at this time, and Wang Shuo has to bite the bullet.

"Gather the generals, follow me to kill."

15 high-level generals quickly gathered and came to the East Gate Tower to surround the general.

[Thunder Skeleton King (Primary General)]

[Level: Level 59]

[Attack Power: 3000]

[Defense Power: 1800]

[Health Value: 32000]

[Skills: Thunder, Red Thunder Slash, Thunderous. ]

When Wang Shuo saw this attack power, his breathing was a little unsmooth.

This -

can kill people in seconds!

No wonder those ordinary soldiers just now were killed with one sword.
